name: toggle-group
purpose: Named group of toggle buttons (aria-pressed) for one setting with a few choices, such as text alignment, a list or grid view, or text styles: single selection (at most one pressed, optionally required) or multiple. Roving tabindex: one button in the tab sequence, arrow keys between buttons.
whenToUse: Switching a view or a formatting state that applies at once: list or grid, bold and italic, alignment.
Two to about seven short choices shown side by side.
whenNotToUse: A form value submitted with other fields: use Radio Group or Checkbox Group.
Commands that run once: use Button or Button Group.
responsive: Inline buttons that wrap (unless attached); vertical orientation stacks them.
rtl: Arrow keys follow the reading direction; logical properties keep the attached radii at the inline ends.
theme: Uses Button tokens; pressed buttons use color-selected, color-selected-text, and color-selected-indicator (contrast gate pairs). Forced colors draw pressed buttons in Highlight.
security: Labels are rendered as text; never parsed as HTML.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Up to 100 items accepted; intended for a handful.

limitations: Not a form control: the value is not submitted with a form (use Radio Group or Checkbox Group for form values).
unsupported: Menus or popups inside the group.
Rich content in items (text and an icon only).
antiPatterns: Changing the item label when it is pressed (aria-pressed already announces the state).
Using a toggle group for navigation.
